roleNote: An example of what you can build from kit components. Start from it, change it, or ignore it; layout is your choice. Follow `must` (kit look and accessibility); `defaults` are this example's suggestions, change any of them.
copyNote: Not exported from agentic-ds-kit. add copies the source into your app (components/patterns/dashboard/) with this contract beside it, and the app-shell example it renders into components/patterns/app-shell/ (kept if you already have it). You own the copies: replace the demo data in dashboard-data.ts, pass your nav through shell, drop the cards you don't need, and keep the `must` lines.
intent: A billing home for a subscription business inside the app-shell example (inset): a title with Export and one solid New invoice, and two Tabs. Overview: four selectable KPIs (MRR, Collected, Overdue, Failed payments) that pick the revenue chart's metric, the revenue LineChart with a labelled reference line and a title that states the finding, a Needs attention rail, and the oldest overdue invoices. Revenue: the period / granularity / compare controls, a dismissible one-sentence summary, MRR movements, revenue by plan, retention by signup month and top plans. Every Overview card has a labelled Ask in its footer that opens the work panel's Ask tab (kit Chat with a context chip); the panel's other tab is What changed.
useWhen: A home page where a few headline numbers each open a closer look in one main chart, next to the work that needs a person today
Billing, recurring revenue or any metric set with this period against the last
A dashboard where people should be able to ask about one card without leaving the page
doNotUseWhen: One list of records to work through — start from list-detail
A page with one number or one chart — compose LineChart or Scoreboard directly
Live operations status that changes by the second — use the agent blocks (RunningNow, AgentMonitor)

metrics.note: DashboardMetric[]: { id, label, value, delta, deltaTone, sparkline, series: { current, previous }, reference: { value, label, highlight }, format, question }. Default: the demo KPIs for period and granularity (MRR, Collected in November, Overdue · 14 invoices, Failed payments · 3). The tiles show label, value and delta (the arrow follows the delta's sign) with what it compares to; sparkline is not drawn here. The chart card's title is built from the last point and reference (e.g. MRR is $7.4k below the $420k target), so name the reference with one word first: Target, Goal or Limit. An empty array is the no-data state: every card shows kit Empty.

selectedMetric.note: Controlled metric id shown in the main chart. Uncontrolled with defaultSelectedMetric (default mrr); onSelectedMetricChange(id) fires from the strip.

compare.note: Controlled: the previous period as a dashed series in the Overview chart. The Switch sits with the period and granularity controls on the Revenue tab. Uncontrolled with defaultCompare (default false); onCompareChange(compare) fires from the Switch.

period.note: Controlled period (Last 30 days, 3 months, 12 months), the presets of the period DateRangePicker on the Revenue tab. It sets how far back the Overview chart and the Revenue charts reach. Uncontrolled with defaultPeriod (default 3m); onPeriodChange(period). A custom range shows its dates in the picker and the demo data of the nearest period.

granularity.note: Controlled bucket size. Uncontrolled with defaultGranularity (default weekly); onGranularityChange(granularity). Options a period does not offer (monthly for 30 days, daily for 12 months) are disabled in the SegmentedControl, and a passed value that does not fit falls back.

insight.note: The one-sentence summary at the top of the Revenue tab, in a kit InsightCard (tone info) with Dismiss. Default: built from the data, key numbers in <strong>. null hides it; onInsightDismiss fires on Dismiss.

rail.note: Needs attention (failed payments, expiring cards) as a kit ListView in a Card. It leads the source order: the first card on a phone, and from the shell's --grid-breakpoint-md the grid places it beside the chart, under the KPIs, with the overdue invoices full width below. false: the chart runs full width.

loading.note: Every card shows kit Skeleton in its place (the invoices Table its loading rows); the summary hides.

panel.note: Work panel start state: { defaultOpen, defaultTab: ask | changes, defaultMessages: ChatMessage[], defaultContext: string }. Closed on Ask by default.

shell.note: AppShellPattern props (nav, workspace, account, layout, className…) merged over the demo shell, so the page takes your app's nav. workPanel and children stay the pattern's.

must: Use kit components from agentic-ds-kit for anything the kit has; no local cousins (tables, dialogs, rows, rules, charts, sparklines, metric tiles)
Semantic tokens only (agentic-ds-kit/tokens.css); no raw hex, no primitive --color-* ramps
Chart series take the chart palette (--chart-1 to --chart-6, set by the charts); status colours only where they mean something (overdue, a failed payment, a bad delta)
Every number uses tabular figures (the page root sets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums)
Exactly one appearance="solid" mode="primary" Button per view: New invoice in the header. Export and every card action are outline
Do not restyle kit components; change them through their props, slots, and tokens
Render inside a main landmark; nav stays reachable on small screens (the app shell's Drawer) and the work panel opens as its right Drawer when narrow
defaults: Shell: the app-shell example (DASHBOARD_DEMO_SHELL): layout inset, layout-shell--viewport, no top bar when wide; Northwind workspace switcher, Quick actions (⌘K), Notifications, Home / Customers / Billing (Invoices, Payments, Plans) / Reports and the account menu; the work panel titled Assistant with Tabs Ask (Chat embedded: no header of its own, fills the panel) and What changed, closed
Header: PageHeader Billing with the sync line as subtitle, Export (outline), New invoice (solid primary) and the panel toggle; Tabs Overview and Revenue

Overview source order: Needs attention, KPIs, overdue invoices, revenue chart. Wide, the grid shows KPIs on top, the chart with the rail (--layout-rail) beside it, then the invoices full width; narrow, one column in source order
KPIs: Scoreboard selectable with four framed Scorecards, each with a delta (arrow and colour) and what it compares to; size sm and no comparison line on a phone, where they go two by two

Revenue chart: a Card with the eyebrow Revenue · metric · granularity, the sync time, a title that states the finding, a LineChart area with the metric's reference line (280 tall wide, 120 narrow), the source line, Ask and Open revenue report (outline, opens the Revenue tab)

Needs attention: a flush Card titled with how many accounts need a person, ListView rows with an icon, the reason in words and the amount as the row value, grouped Failed payments and Cards expiring; on a phone the expiring cards fold into one row. Ask and Retry 3 payments (outline) in the footer

Overdue invoices: a flush Card titled with the count and total, a Table (stack) oldest first with Customer, Invoice, an Overdue Badge with its icon, Due with days late (sortable) and Amount, a row menu, the source line, Ask and View all (outline)
Cards use Card size md wide and sm narrow

Revenue tab: the period DateRangePicker (sm, in a Field labelled Period at the start) with the presets Last 30 days, Last 3 months and Last 12 months, or a custom range of days; granularity SegmentedControl; Compare to previous period Switch; the InsightCard summary; MRR movements (ComboChart stacked, net line); Revenue by plan as a short percent stack (height 160); then a row of two in layout-split: Retention by signup month (Heatmap) and Top plans (BarList in a Card)

panel: Ask open with a context chip and suggestions

requirements: Reading order matches the phone layout: header, Needs attention, KPIs, overdue invoices, chart. The rail is placed by grid when wide, not moved in the source
KPIs: Scoreboard selectable is a radiogroup named Metric shown in the chart; one tab stop, arrow keys move and pick, Home and End jump; the chart card's title follows the pick

The chart card's title states the finding, the reference line has a text label, and a visually hidden sentence reads the start, the end and the distance to the reference; the chart sits directly in the Card body, so it keeps its Table view without a second frame

Ask is a labelled sm Button in each Overview card's footer (Card askLabel); the Revenue tab's charts keep an icon-only Ask named Ask about <card>. The Chat composer is described by the context chip (Asking about <card> · <period>)

Status reads in words: Needs attention rows say the reason, invoices carry an Overdue Badge and days late, deltas an arrow and what they compare to. Icons are aria-hidden; colour is never the only signal
The Compare Switch and the period DateRangePicker have visible names; disabled granularity options stay in the group

doNot: Do not build a sparkline, metric tile, reference line or context chip locally; Scorecard, Scoreboard selectable, LineChart referenceLine and Chat context cover them
Do not colour chart series by status; losses in MRR movements are negative values, not red bars
Do not put more than five tiles in the KPI strip
Do not add a second solid primary Button; card actions are outline
Do not reorder the rail with CSS order or a second copy; it leads the source and the grid places it
Do not open a Modal for Ask; use the work panel (a right Drawer when narrow)
